segments.title: Pride Month Kickoff and Fish Tie Frenzy
segments.notes: Hype Train commandeers the open with a Pride month greeting, then derails into a prolonged fish-tie shopping tangent and a surreal 'fish vs chat' war monologue before Pepito restores order.

segments.title: Gaza Aid Line Killings and Greta Thunberg's Flotilla
segments.notes: Rick joins the news desk for a contentious discussion of the UN call for investigation into Israeli fire on a Gaza food line, Lindsey Graham's threat to Greta Thunberg's aid ship, and America's Funniest Home Videos nostalgia.

segments.title: Billy Ray Cyrus Achy Breaky Heart Flashback
segments.notes: Case and Rick watch a 1992 America's Funniest Home Videos clip of Billy Ray Cyrus promoting the Achy Breaky dance contest, followed by the winning viewer submission featuring paramedics.

segments.title: Musical Gorilla vs Bald Gambling Addict Debate
segments.notes: Munch and Crum clash over a hypothetical fight; Crum argues the addict would ally with the gorilla, Munch insists on a football-field death match. Gambling debt ledger dispute erupts mid-debate.

segments.title: Gordon Robertson Interview (Hugh Jackman Impersonator)
segments.notes: A caller claiming to be 700 Club's Gordon Robertson appears but insists he is Hugh Jackman wearing 'putty flesh'; Case and Pepito play along until the bit collapses into a flood prayer.

segments.title: Evil Twin Identification Panel
segments.notes: Crum, Grandma Crumble Bottom, Pepito, and Christ field chat questions to expose an evil twin; reveals include Grandma's janitor-closet origin, Pepito's litter cannibalism, and Christ's humanitarian twin in Gaza.

segments.title: Park Interviews: Al Manchester, Ayatollah Kermani, and Ghost of Rob LV
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein fields a parade of park denizens including a returning Al Manchester, a superpowered Ayatollah Kermani, a fungus monster actor, and an aggressive Rob LV ghost; Trip debuts a three-strike fan ejection rule.

segments.title: Discord News Rundown: FEMA Chief, Circumcision Regret, and Toilet Snake
segments.notes: Rapid-fire headlines: FEMA director unaware of hurricane season, January 6 pardon refusal, porn star circumcision regret, Russian bomber losses, King of the Hill voice actor killed, 3D-printed spire, R-Truth WWE firing, Trump intelligence briefing revamp, Biden clone Truth Social post, UK 'woke' roundabout, 50 Cent vs Diddy, Twitch vertical streaming, Elon Musk ketamine bladder damage, German church chicken-diaper performance, Oreo lawsuit, and an 11-foot toilet snake penis bite.

segments.title: Raid Outro to Christine Te Latte
segments.notes: Case abandons a snake-bite sketch pitch, thanks top chatters, and raids Christine Te Latte's Minecraft stream.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored the broadcast, wrangled Hype Train's fish tangent, debated Rick on Gaza, moderated Munch & Crum debt dispute, hosted Jumbalaya evil twin panel, and closed with a toilet-snake sketch pitch.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype correspondent. Opened the show with a Pride month rampage, invented a fish-vs-chat war cosmology, and demanded a fish-tie rap beat before self-terminating.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Managed scene transitions, admitted to eating corporate goldfish and litter-mate puppies, fed Crum lines during Jumbalaya, and operated the papal binclave set.

characters.name: Rick
characters.notes: Amongst the Web host. Co-hosted the news block, defended Israel's warning-shot narrative, celebrated a world-government One Piece stance, and riffed on America's Funniest Home Videos history.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued a bald gambling addict would befriend a musical gorilla, negotiated his $60k-70k gorilla debt on air, revealed therapy progress with his wife, and called into Trip's park segment to harass Al Manchester.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: debate analyst. Insisted the gorilla would pulp Crum on a 49ers field, revealed an 'Only Munch' OnlyFans for wolves, and refused to update the debt graphic despite Crum's three straight wins.

characters.name: Grandma Crumble Bottom
characters.notes: Jambalaya panelist. Disclosed her janitor-closet origin and mulch-and-gravel diet while denying evil twin status.

characters.name: Christ
characters.notes: Jambalaya panelist. Revealed his twin brother is a pro bono doctor in Gaza, admitted a past 'evil twin' phase, and resisted Case's attempts to extract self-worth.

characters.name: Trip Bradstein
characters.notes: field correspondent. Conducted bush interviews from the park, enforced a new three-strike fan-ejection rule, and fended off a ghostly Rob LV and a superpowered Ayatollah Kermani.

characters.name: Liliana
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Briefly cued for Jumbalaya but did not materialize on mic before the segment began.

storylines.beat: [59:04] Crum's gorilla gambling debt recalculated to ~$60k-70k; Munch pays $5k per Crum win but refuses to update graphic; Crum claims three consecutive debate victories.
[31:49] Case references pending Beyblade event possibly still 'inside the Papal Binclave'; no further advancement this episode.

lore_notes.fact: Crum states he is in therapy with his wife and identifies as a recovering addict.
Munch operates a secret 'Only Mush' OnlyFans for 'wolves' subscribers.
Grandma Crumble Bottom originated under the sink of a high school janitor's closet.
Grandma Crumble Bottom consumes only mulch and gravel; everything else disagrees with her stomach.
Pepito admits to eating some of his 48 litter-mate puppies.
Christ's twin brother is a humanitarian doctor currently working in Gaza.
Trip Bradstein institutes a three-strike 'fan ejection' rule for repeat park interviewees.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News opened with Hype Train's fish-themed Pride rampage before pivoting to a fractious news block on Gaza aid-line killings and Greta Thunberg's flotilla. The broadcast devolved into a Billy Ray Cyrus nostalgia hole, a Munch & Crum debate that exposed Crum's six-figure gorilla debt, a Jambalaya evil-twin panel revealing Grandma Crumble Bottom's janitor-closet genesis, and a chaotic Trip on the Street featuring a superpowered Ayatollah and a ghostly Rob LV. The episode closed with a rapid discord news rundown culminating in an 11-foot toilet snake penis-bite story and a raid on Christine Te Latte.
